constellations.desc: The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}Compound Sedation Field{/LINK}</color> has its duration extended to 3s.\nAdditionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Compound Sedation Field</color>.

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}Compound Sedation Field{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Vow of Universal Coexistence

constellations.desc: When Ifa uses the Hold version of his {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK}, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.\nAdditionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.
constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot

passives.desc: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 {LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>Rescue Essentials</color>{/LINK} point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.
passives.name: Field Medic's Vision

passives.desc: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.
passives.name: Mutual Aid Agreement

passives.desc: After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing.\nWhile in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue

passives.desc: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, when the current active party member or indwelt saurian has less than 40% HP, Ifa will consume 10 Phlogiston and restore 40% of their HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging

skills.desc:

Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires off a shot, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

skills.desc:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the {LINK#N11130003}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>{/LINK} state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Airborne Disease Prevention</color> while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
skills.name: Airborne Disease Prevention

const1.name: 藤典药剂的备制

const2.description: 伊法处于夜魂加持状态下时，基于队伍中所有角色当前夜魂值的总和超过60点的部分，每1点夜魂值都将使伊法额外获得4点{LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>「救援要义」</color>{/LINK}。\n此外，伊法持有「救援要义」的上限提升50点。\n需要解锁突破天赋{LINK#P1132101}<color=#FFD780FF>场中医者视野</color>{/LINK}。
const2.name: 祈祷弹道的助灵

const3.name: 与夜谈判的驳词

const4.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}复合镇静域{/LINK}</color>产生的固缚风场的持续时间延长至3秒。\n此外，施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>复合镇静域</color>后，伊法的元素精通提升100点，持续15秒。
const4.name: 糜烂应体的置换

const5.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}复合镇静域{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 万物同生的共誓

const6.description: 伊法长按进行{LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>「援护射击」</color>{/LINK}时，有50%几率发射一枚额外的秘药弹，造成相当于伊法攻击力120%的风元素伤害。该伤害视为普通攻击伤害。\n此外，不处于战斗状态下时，伊法的夜魂加持状态消耗的夜魂值与燃素降低20%。
const6.name: 羽结所庇的诺言

hyperlinks.description:
在夜魂加持状态下，伊法的普通攻击将会转为进行援护射击。
点按
发射秘药弹。
长按
持续发射秘药弹。
秘药弹
造成具有夜魂性质的风元素伤害，并在命中敌人时为队伍中附近的所有角色恢复生命值，回复量受益于伊法自己的元素精通。
hyperlinks.name: 援护射击

hyperlinks.description: 上限为150点。基于伊法持有的救援要义，每1点救援要义会使队伍中附近的角色触发的扩散反应与感电反应造成的伤害提升1.5%，月感电反应造成的伤害提升0.2%，星扩散反应造成的伤害提升0.2%。救援要义将在伊法的夜魂加持结束时被移除。
hyperlinks.name: 救援要义

hyperlinks.description: 持续消耗夜魂值。夜魂值耗尽时，或是再次施放时，伊法的夜魂加持将会结束。夜魂加持状态具有如下特性：\n·在咔库库的帮助下悬浮，提升伊法的移动速度与抗打断能力，在这种状态下，伊法将持续消耗夜魂值，维持悬浮状态，进行冲刺或抬升高度时，将额外消耗夜魂值。\n·进行普通攻击时，将依据点按、长按，转为以不同的方式进行「援护射击」。
hyperlinks.name: 夜魂加持·伊法

hyperlinks.description: 该效果会在片刻后爆发消失，并造成对应元素属性的范围伤害。至多对4名命中的敌人施加「镇静标记」；敌人无法同时处于多种元素属性的「镇静标记」状态下。
hyperlinks.name: 镇静标记

cv.EN: 乔尼·罗夸斯妥&多米尼克·卡特兰博内

info.description: 来自花羽会的兽医，由衷热爱着与人、动物，以及其他生灵为伴的生活。
info.name: 伊法
info.title: 蔚风引灵

p1.description: 伊法处于夜魂加持状态下时，将基于队伍中所有角色当前夜魂值的总和，每1点夜魂值都将使伊法获得1点{LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>「救援要义」</color>{/LINK}。救援要义可以提升队伍中附近的角色触发的扩散、星扩散、感电、月感电反应造成的伤害。
p1.name: 场中医者视野

p2.description: 队伍中的附近的角色触发「夜魂迸发」时，伊法的元素精通提升80点，持续10秒。
p2.name: 互助救援协议

p3.description: 在夜魂值耗竭后，伊法将会转而消耗燃素来维持夜魂加持。\n在纳塔存在燃素机制的区域时，能够进行夜魂传递·伊法。当前场上角色位于一定高度的空中时，切换伊法登场时触发：伊法将进入夜魂加持状态，并获得32点夜魂值。自己的队伍每10秒可以触发一次夜魂传递。
p3.name: 夜域赐礼·集念急救

p4.description: 在纳塔存在燃素机制的区域时，队伍中自己的当前场上角色或受魂附的龙生命值低于40%时，伊法将消耗10点燃素为其恢复40%生命值。该效果每10秒至多触发一次，在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
p4.name: 温敷战术包扎

elementalburst.description: 向（暂时还没有冷静下来的）敌人发射一枚疗域镇静剂。疗域镇静剂将在命中时炸裂，产生固缚风场，牵引附近的物品与敌人，并造成具有夜魂性质的风元素范围伤害。 疗域镇静剂命中处于水元素/火元素/冰元素/雷元素附着下的敌人时，会为这些敌人施加{LINK#N11130004}「镇静标记」{/LINK}效果。 「进行治疗前，首先得让病患们冷静下来，至于方法…靠子弹也行，来吧，咔库库。」 「一起上吧，哥们！」
elementalburst.name: 复合镇静域

elementalskill.description: 到好哥们出场的时候了，哥们！伊法唤来咔库库一同战斗。 施放后，伊法将获得80点夜魂值，并进入{LINK#N11130003}夜魂加持{/LINK}状态。夜魂加持状态期间，伊法将在咔库库的帮助下悬浮，进行普通攻击时，将依据点按、长按，转为以不同的方式进行{LINK#N11130001}「援护射击」{/LINK}，发射能够为队伍中所有角色恢复生命值的秘药弹。 此外，在夜魂加持状态下，长按施放元素战技空天疾护时，伊法将转为进行具有夜魂性质的下落攻击，松开技能时可以中断下落攻击，并维持悬浮状态；在下落攻击过程中落地时，伊法的夜魂加持将会结束。 「治疗伤痛，就得先解决根源，那句话怎么说的…先救命，后治伤？」 「是这样，哥们！」
elementalskill.name: 空天疾护

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多三段的攻击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方射击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。
normalattack.name: 祛风妙仪

Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.
passives.name: Field Medic's Vision

passives.desc: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.
passives.name: Mutual Aid Agreement

passives.desc: After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing.\nWhile in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue

passives.desc: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, when the current active party member or indwelt saurian has less than 40% HP, Ifa will consume 10 Phlogiston and restore 40% of their HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires off a shot, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.
skills.name: Rite of Dispelling Winds

skills.desc:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the {LINK#N11130003}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>{/LINK} state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Airborne Disease Prevention</color> while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
skills.name: Airborne Disease Prevention

skills.desc: Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.\nWhen the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>/<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>/<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>/<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, it will apply a {LINK#N11130004}<color=#FFD780FF>Sedation Mark</color>{/LINK} to them.
skills.name: Compound Sedation Field

constellations.desc: {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>「援护射击」</color>{/LINK}命中敌人时，将为伊法恢复6点元素能量。每8秒至多通过这种方式恢复一次元素能量。
constellations.name: 藤典药剂的备制

constellations.desc: 伊法处于夜魂加持状态下时，基于队伍中所有角色当前夜魂值的总和超过60点的部分，每1点夜魂值都将使伊法额外获得4点{LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>「救援要义」</color>{/LINK}。\n此外，伊法持有「救援要义」的上限提升50点。\n需要解锁突破天赋{LINK#P1132101}<color=#FFD780FF>场中医者视野</color>{/LINK}。
constellations.name: 祈祷弹道的助灵

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11132}空天疾护{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 与夜谈判的驳词

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}复合镇静域{/LINK}</color>产生的固缚风场的持续时间延长至3秒。\n此外，施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>复合镇静域</color>后，伊法的元素精通提升100点，持续15秒。
constellations.name: 糜烂应体的置换

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}复合镇静域{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 万物同生的共誓

constellations.desc: 伊法长按进行{LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>「援护射击」</color>{/LINK}时，有50%几率发射一枚额外的秘药弹，造成相当于伊法攻击力120%的风元素伤害。该伤害视为普通攻击伤害。\n此外，不处于战斗状态下时，伊法的夜魂加持状态消耗的夜魂值与燃素降低20%。
constellations.name: 羽结所庇的诺言

passives.desc: 伊法处于夜魂加持状态下时，将基于队伍中所有角色当前夜魂值的总和，每1点夜魂值都将使伊法获得1点{LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>「救援要义」</color>{/LINK}。救援要义可以提升队伍中附近的角色触发的扩散、星扩散、感电、月感电反应造成的伤害。
passives.name: 场中医者视野

passives.desc: 队伍中的附近的角色触发「夜魂迸发」时，伊法的元素精通提升80点，持续10秒。
passives.name: 互助救援协议

passives.desc: 在夜魂值耗竭后，伊法将会转而消耗燃素来维持夜魂加持。\n在纳塔存在燃素机制的区域时，能够进行夜魂传递·伊法。当前场上角色位于一定高度的空中时，切换伊法登场时触发：伊法将进入夜魂加持状态，并获得32点夜魂值。自己的队伍每10秒可以触发一次夜魂传递。
passives.name: 夜域赐礼·集念急救

passives.desc: 在纳塔存在燃素机制的区域时，队伍中自己的当前场上角色或受魂附的龙生命值低于40%时，伊法将消耗10点燃素为其恢复40%生命值。该效果每10秒至多触发一次，在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
passives.name: 温敷战术包扎

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多三段的攻击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方射击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。
skills.name: 祛风妙仪

skills.desc:
到好哥们出场的时候了，哥们！伊法唤来咔库库一同战斗。
施放后，伊法将获得80点夜魂值，并进入{LINK#N11130003}<color=#FFD780FF>夜魂加持</color>{/LINK}状态。夜魂加持状态期间，伊法将在咔库库的帮助下悬浮，进行普通攻击时，将依据点按、长按，转为以不同的方式进行{LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>「援护射击」</color>{/LINK}，发射能够为队伍中所有角色恢复生命值的秘药弹。

此外，在夜魂加持状态下，长按施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>空天疾护</color>时，伊法将转为进行具有夜魂性质的下落攻击，松开技能时可以中断下落攻击，并维持悬浮状态；在下落攻击过程中落地时，伊法的夜魂加持将会结束。
skills.name: 空天疾护

skills.desc: 向（暂时还没有冷静下来的）敌人发射一枚疗域镇静剂。疗域镇静剂将在命中时炸裂，产生固缚风场，牵引附近的物品与敌人，并造成具有夜魂性质的<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。\n疗域镇静剂命中处于<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>/<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>/<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>/<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>附着下的敌人时，会为这些敌人施加{LINK#N11130004}<color=#FFD780FF>「镇静标记」</color>{/LINK}效果。
skills.name: 复合镇静域
